operations.sql: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '10s'

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) AND (e1.arch_type = $4 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $5 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $5)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
COMMIT
